caption: One image per class: the original, the preprocessed 128 by 256 image (CLAHE, resize, blur, black-hat) and the HOG picture computed from it, drawn with the project's own preprocessing and feature code. Images (numbered in the figure) are cropped and rescaled from: (1) Murthy et al. (2024), doi:10.1038/s41598-024-51164-x, specimen GGBS20-Vf1, CC BY 4.0; (2) Yoo (2022), doi:10.3390/ma15093091, specimen BS-2.5T, CC BY 4.0; (3) Hadi et al. (2026), doi:10.3390/ma19173660, specimen BTRM-3-NA, CC BY 4.0.
strings: Preprocessing makes cracks bright lines, and HOG records their direction in every 16-pixel cell.
